name: steph62
caption:
62 AT AGE 32? 🎮🏀 Steph Curry was 32. He scored 62.

• Jan 3, 2021 vs Portland: a career high
• 18 of 31 from the field, 8 of 16 from three
• We win 137-122
• Now he's 38, and still at 30.6 a night in his first 9 games

Can Steph drop 60 again at 38? 👇
